not_claimed: Backward overlapping copy, aligned SIMD paths, other lengths or feature dispatch

premises: Length is 32 through 127 and both exclusive buffer ends remain representable unsigned words
Destination is at or below source or begins at or beyond the source exclusive end
Entry DF is zero and stable mapped feature DWORD RVA 0x00493f30 has bit one set
MOVDQU architectural execution and XMM register state are available under the declared instruction semantics
All buffer byte alignments are permitted; accesses remain entirely inside the requested intervals

scope.relation: Destination equals original source snapshot and other payload bytes stay unchanged; each 32 byte iteration reads both 16 byte source halves before storing either half; EAX returns destination and saved GPRs restore
scope.xmm_relation: XMM0 and XMM1 are the final original 32 byte block halves; XMM2 through XMM7 are preserved
